name: term_id
description: openparliament.ca membership URL path (/politicians/memberships/<n>/). Primary key.

name: role
description: 'MP' (House of Commons member). Other roles are not modelled yet.

name: end_date
description: Term end; NULL while the term is open.

name: party
description: Party short name during the term.

name: riding_name
description: Riding name as openparliament.ca publishes it for this term. Context only: never a join key (numbers and names changed across electoral maps; see docs/design/people-spine.md).

name: label
description: openparliament.ca's label, e.g. 'Conservative MP for Avalon'.

name: run_id
description: Curate run that last wrote this row.
